title: Combining Results from Multiple Tools
query: Get weather for New York and London, then compare the temperatures

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather for a city

explanation: This demonstrates RESULT COMBINING across multiple tool calls. Steps 1-2 gather data from both cities (can run in parallel). Step 3 combines results by comparing the temperature values. Note: {{stepN.field}} notation shows we're using outputs from previous steps. This pattern is common: gather data from multiple sources, then aggregate/compare/analyze.
learning_points: Complex queries often need multiple tool calls
First gather data, then process/compare it
Step 3 depends on 1 and 2 (must run after)
Track which outputs feed into which inputs
